symptom: A `/** … */` doc comment between `alter entity … add attribute` clauses is a **parse error** (`no viable alternative at input '/**'`)
cause: `alterEntityAction` accepted a doc comment only INSIDE an `attributeDefinition` (after the ADD ATTRIBUTE keyword), not between clauses. `--` line comments are NOT an equivalent workaround — they are discarded, whereas a `/** */` doc comment is persisted as the attribute's Mendix documentation
insight: Add `docComment?` before `ADD ATTRIBUTE`/`ADD COLUMN`; the visitor attaches it as the added attribute's documentation when the attributeDefinition has none. `make grammar` regenerates the parser (not committed). Test `TestAlterEntityAddAttributeDocComment`; repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/traceops-27-doc-comment-between-clauses.mdl`. traceops #27
